notes: Target Australia (target.com.au) - separate corporate entity from Target US per prior Home-Decor pass notes (archive c207), not cross-referenced. Access: curl_cffi impersonate=safari17_2_ios reached /c/home/W99700, /c/home/pets/W803706, /c/home/pets/dog-supplies/W803716 and /c/home/pets/cat-supplies/W803719 directly (200, full SSR HTML). All 13 individual leaf PLPs (e.g. /c/home/pets/dog-supplies/beds/W1199495) returned Akamai 403 under the same profile - stopped requesting those leaf URLs directly (first-block rule) and instead queried the site's own Constructor.io browse API (ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<ID>?key=key_kWcXakjuyHSxpu75), the exact same count source the prior pass verified is embedded in every PLP as data-cnstrc-num-results (not a raw/inflated storefront total). Cross-verified two independent ways: (1) a direct per-leaf group_id query returning total_num_results, and (2) the parent Dog Supplies / Cat Supplies group's own 'groups' tree listing each child's count inline - both matched exactly for all 13 leaves, so treated as exact site-reported counts. Checked scope: Pets lives only under Home (/c/home/pets/W803706, labelled 'Pet Range' in nav, 445 products total) with exactly two children, Dog Supplies (313) and Cat Supplies (158), confirmed via Constructor's own group tree (no bird/fish/small-animal sub-departments exist). Checked the site-wide top department bar (Beauty, Clearance, Denim, Disney, Entertainment, Gifts, Home, Kids, Matching Pyjama Sets, Men, School, Sport & Outdoor, Toys, Women) and full-text-scanned the Home landing page for any other 'pet' mention outside the Pets hub - none found, so Pets-under-Home is the sole Pet Care location on this site. Dog Supplies has 7 leaf children (Beds, Bowls, Food, Grooming & Hygiene, Leads/Collars/Harnesses, Pet Apparel, Toys); Cat Supplies has 6 discoverable leaf links but one (Leads, Collars & Harnesses, W1199684) returned total_num_results=0 and was dropped per zero-qty rule, leaving 5 populated cat leaves. Dog/Cat Supplies parent totals (313/158) do not equal the sum of their listed children (255/130) - normal faceting behaviour on this site (parent 'shop all' pages are broader supersets), not recomputed or overridden. Flagged both Food leaves as pet-consumable per open policy gap (title-sampled: Anko-brand dog/cat treats and food). Grooming & Hygiene leaves title-sampled and confirmed in-scope (litter, waste bags, potty mats, brushes, clippers - not medical/veterinary).
